ex.en: You can omit the last chapter of the book.
ex.zh: 你可以略過這本書的最後一章。

ex.en: Omit this word in your sentence because it's not necessary.
ex.zh: 把句子裡的這個字刪掉，因為它是多餘的。

ex.en: In French, you can rarely omit the subject.
ex.zh: 在法語中，主詞很少能省略。

ex.en: Dark clouds gathered, giving an ominous sign of a storm.
ex.zh: 烏雲聚集，預示著暴風雨即將來臨。

ex.en: An ominous silence followed his words.
ex.zh: 他說完後出現了一陣不祥的沉默。

ominous.en: suggesting that something bad is going to happen

ex.en: The omission of one number made the whole answer wrong.
ex.zh: 漏掉一個數字，使整個答案都錯了。

ex.en: She noticed the omission of his name from the list.
ex.zh: 她注意到名單上漏掉了他的名字。

ex.en: The report was criticized for several important omissions.
ex.zh: 這份報告因為幾處重要的遺漏而受到批評。

ex.en: Some people believe a black cat is a bad omen.
ex.zh: 有些人相信黑貓是壞兆頭。

ex.en: The early snow was seen as an omen of a long winter.
ex.zh: 這場早雪被視為漫長冬天的預兆。

ex.en: She took her complaint to the ombudsman after the bank ignored her.
ex.zh: 銀行不理會她之後，她把申訴交給了監察專員。

ex.en: The ombudsman looks into complaints about public services.
ex.zh: 監察專員負責調查對公共服務的申訴。

ex.en: The sky darkened ominously before the storm.
ex.zh: 暴風雨前天空不祥地暗了下來。

ex.en: The phone rang ominously in the middle of the night.
ex.zh: 半夜電話響起，感覺不太對勁。

ex.en: I made a cheese omelet for breakfast.
ex.zh: 我早餐做了一份起司煎蛋捲。

ex.en: You can't make an omelet without breaking eggs.
ex.zh: 不打破蛋就做不成煎蛋捲。

ex.en: I made a cheese omelette for breakfast this morning.
ex.zh: 我今天早上做了一份起司歐姆蛋當早餐。

ex.en: You can't make an omelette without breaking eggs.
ex.zh: 不打破雞蛋就做不成蛋捲，意思是想成事就得有所犧牲。

ex.en: Oman is a country on the Arabian Peninsula.
ex.zh: 阿曼是位於阿拉伯半島上的國家。

ex.en: The capital of Oman is Muscat.
ex.zh: 阿曼的首都是馬斯喀特。

ex.en: Smartphones are omnipresent in modern life.
ex.zh: 智慧型手機在現代生活中無所不在。

ex.en: The omnipresent noise of the city kept him awake.
ex.zh: 城市裡無處不在的噪音讓他睡不著。

ex.en: He bought an omnibus of all three novels.
ex.zh: 他買了這三本小說的合輯。

ex.en: The omnibus edition includes several short stories.
ex.zh: 這本合輯收錄了好幾篇短篇故事。
